Everflowing Goblet.name: Everflowing Goblet
Everflowing Goblet.effect: You can heal past your max health at 20 efficiency.
Everflowing Goblet.effectCn: 允许通过治疗效果超出最大生命值上限（20效率）。

Vampiric Sword.name: Vampiric Sword
Vampiric Sword.effect: Each kill heals you by 5. but each shot you take deals 2 damage to you.
Vampiric Sword.effectCn: 每次击杀敌人将为你恢复5生命值，但是被射中时你将承受2点伤害。

Baby Rattle.name: Baby Rattle
Baby Rattle.effect: Gain 150x baby balls, but your aim becomes scattered.
Baby Rattle.effectCn: 获得150x迷你弹珠，但是开火时无法精确瞄准。

War Horn.name: War Horn
War Horn.effect: All baby balls deal 20 more damage
War Horn.effectCn: 所有迷你弹珠额外造成20伤害

Ethereal Cloak.name: Ethereal Cloak
Ethereal Cloak.effect: Balls go through enemies and deal 25 bonus damage until they hit the back of the field
Ethereal Cloak.effectCn: 弹珠能够穿过敌人并造成25额外伤害，此效果持续至弹珠命中屏幕上方的尽头区域。

Ghostly Corset.name: Ghostly Corset
Ghostly Corset.effect: Balls go through enemies and deal 20 bonus damage when hitting them from the side
Ghostly Corset.effectCn: 从两侧命中敌人时，弹珠将穿过敌人并造成20额外伤害

Wretched Onion.name: Wretched Onion
Wretched Onion.effect: Deal 6-12 per second to enemies within 2 tiles.
Wretched Onion.effectCn: 每秒对2格范围内的敌人造成6-12点伤害

Reacher's Spear.name: Reacher's Spear
Reacher's Spear.effect: Increase crit chance to 200 when hitting enemies in the same column as you.
Reacher's Spear.effectCn: 命中与你处于同一列的敌人时，暴击率提高至200。

Crown of Thorns.name: Crown of Thorns
Crown of Thorns.effect: Destroy the 2 nearest enemies when you are hit from close range
Crown of Thorns.effectCn: 承受近距离攻击时，摧毁距离你最近的2个敌人

Spiked Collar.name: Spiked Collar
Spiked Collar.effect: Deal 30-50 to enemies the first time you get into their melee attack range.
Spiked Collar.effectCn: 首次进入敌人的近战攻击范围时，对其造成30-50伤害。

Fleet Feet.name: Fleet Feet
Fleet Feet.effect: Increase movement speed by 10 and move at full speed while shooting.
Fleet Feet.effectCn: 你的移动速度提高10，并且能够在开火时全速移动。

Radiant Feather.name: Radiant Feather
Radiant Feather.effect: Increase ball launch speed by 20, but get knocked back a little each time you shoot a ball
Radiant Feather.effectCn: 弹珠发射初速提高20，但是每次发射弹珠时后坐力将会把你微微推开。

Diamond Hilted Dagger.name: Diamond Hilted Dagger
Diamond Hilted Dagger.effect: Increase crit chance to 200 when hitting enemies in the front.
Diamond Hilted Dagger.effectCn: 攻击敌人的正面时，暴击率提高至200。

Emerald Hilted Dagger.name: Emerald Hilted Dagger
Emerald Hilted Dagger.effect: Increase crit chance to 300 when hitting enemies on their right side.
Emerald Hilted Dagger.effectCn: 攻击敌人的右侧时，暴击率提高至300。

Ruby Hilted Dagger.name: Ruby Hilted Dagger
Ruby Hilted Dagger.effect: Increase crit chance to 150 when hitting enemies in the back.
Ruby Hilted Dagger.effectCn: 攻击敌人的背面时，暴击率提高至150。

Sapphire Hilted Dagger.name: Sapphire Hilted Dagger
Sapphire Hilted Dagger.effect: Increase crit chance to 300 when hitting enemies on their left side.
Sapphire Hilted Dagger.effectCn: 攻击敌人的左侧时，暴击率提高至300。

Ghostly Shield.name: Ghostly Shield
Ghostly Shield.effect: Balls go through allies and heal them for 2 health
Ghostly Shield.effectCn: 弹珠能够穿过友方单位并为其恢复2点生命值

Kiss of Death.name: Kiss of Death
Kiss of Death.effect: Charmed enemies have a 10 chance of dying after recovering.
Kiss of Death.effectCn: 被魅惑的敌人在魅惑效果结束时有10几率死亡。

Lover's Quiver.name: Lover's Quiver
Lover's Quiver.effect: Projectiles have a 40 chance to heal you for 1 health instead of hurting you.
Lover's Quiver.effectCn: 投射物有40%的几率为你恢复1点生命值，而不是对你造成伤害。

Protective Charm.name: Protective Charm
Protective Charm.effect: Gain a shield that blocks the next damage you would receive. Recharges after 60 seconds.
Protective Charm.effectCn: 获得一面能够抵挡1次伤害的盾牌。盾牌将在触发效果的60秒后重新充能。

Rubber Headband.name: Rubber Headband
Rubber Headband.effect: Balls start off at 70 speed but increase by 20 each bounce (max 200).
Rubber Headband.effectCn: 弹珠初速变为70，但是每次反弹将使速度提高20（最高200）。

Silver Blindfold.name: Silver Blindfold
Silver Blindfold.effect: Increase crit chance to 200 when hitting blinded enemies.
Silver Blindfold.effectCn: 命中致盲的敌人时，暴击率提高至200。

Traitor's Cowl.name: Traitor's Cowl
Traitor's Cowl.effect: Stone allies can now be damaged by your balls, but you heal by 2 when a ball hits one.
Traitor's Cowl.effectCn: 你的弹珠将对各类岩石友军造成伤害，但是每次命中这些友军时，你将恢复2生命值。

Upturned Hatchet.name: Upturned Hatchet
Upturned Hatchet.effect: Balls deal 80 more damage after hitting the back of the field, otherwise damage is reduced by 20.
Upturned Hatchet.effectCn: 弹珠命中屏幕上方的尽头区域后伤害提高80，但没有命中时伤害降低20。

Voodoo Doll.name: Voodoo Doll
Voodoo Doll.effect: Curse has a 10 chance of killing enemies

Archer's Effigy.name: Archer's Effigy
Archer's Effigy.effect: Every 7 - 12 rows, spawn a stone archer with 160 health on your side. Stone archers are immune to ball damage and shoot arrows at enemies, dealing 10-20 each.
Archer's Effigy.effectCn: 每隔7-12行，从你的这一侧生成1个拥有160生命值的岩石弓手。岩石弓手免疫弹珠伤害，并且会朝敌人发射箭矢，每枚箭矢造成10-20伤害。

Artificial Heart.name: Artificial Heart
Artificial Heart.effectCn: 友方单位获得额外100生命值

Bandage Roll.name: Bandage Roll
Bandage Roll.effect: Shoot 1-2 baby balls each time you're healed.
Bandage Roll.effectCn: 每次恢复生命值时发射1-2颗迷你弹珠。

Cursed Elixir.name: Cursed Elixir
Cursed Elixir.effect: When a poisoned enemy dies, 10 chance for them to come back as a zombie with 240 health that moves up the board and fights enemies
Cursed Elixir.effectCn: 如果中毒的敌人死亡，它们有10几率复活为僵尸，僵尸拥有240生命值，并且会向上方移动并攻击敌人

Dynamite.name: Dynamite
Dynamite.effect: Every 5 - 10 rows, spawn an enemy with dynamite attached to them. Destroying them will deal 200 - 500 damage to nearby enemies.
Dynamite.effectCn: 每隔5-10行，生成1个携带着雷管的敌人。摧毁这些敌人将对其附近的其他敌人造成200-500伤害。

Frozen Spike.name: Frozen Spike
Frozen Spike.effect: When an enemy is frozen, they emit a chill to nearby enemies that deals 10-20 damage
Frozen Spike.effectCn: 被冰冻的敌人将释放寒气，并对周遭的敌人造成10-20伤害

Gemspring.name: Gemspring
Gemspring.effect: Every 7 - 11 rows, spawn a Gemspring. Dealing damage to them causes them to drop an increasing amount of XP gems.
Gemspring.effectCn: 每隔7-11行，生成一口宝石泉。对泉水造成伤害将使其掉落更多的经验值宝石。

Golden Bull.name: Golden Bull
Golden Bull.effect: Every 7 - 11 rows, spawn a golden bull with 400 health on your side. Golden bulls accrue  10 <sprite name=gold> per minute. They also move up the field, blocking and attacking enemies in the way.
Golden Bull.effectCn: 每隔7-11行，从你的这一侧生成1个拥有400生命值的黄金公牛。黄金公牛每分钟积累10 <sprite name=gold>。除此以外，黄金公牛会向上方移动，阻挡并攻击敌人。

Healer's Effigy.name: Healer's Effigy
Healer's Effigy.effect: Every 7 - 12 rows, spawn a stone healer with 100 health on your side, which heals you 10 health per minute while it's on the field. Healers are immune to ball damage and move up the field, blocking and attacking enemies in the way.
Healer's Effigy.effectCn: 每隔7-12行，从你的这一侧生成1个生命值为100的岩石治疗师，在场上时，治疗师将每分钟为你恢复10点生命值。治疗师免疫弹珠伤害，除此以外还会向上方移动，而且会阻挡并攻击敌人。

Magic Staff.name: Magic Staff
Magic Staff.effect: Increase area-of-effect damage (such as earthquake, laser, and lightning) by 20
Magic Staff.effectCn: 使范围伤害（例如地震、激光或闪电等）提高20

Midnight Oil.name: Midnight Oil
Midnight Oil.effect: Balls that hit flaming enemies light on fire and deal 10-20 bonus fire damage on the next hit.
Midnight Oil.effectCn: 如果命中承受燃烧效果的敌人，弹珠将被点燃，并且将在下一次命中时造成10-20额外火焰伤害。

Stone Effigy.name: Stone Effigy
Stone Effigy.effect: Every 7 - 12 rows, spawn a stone soldier with 200 health on your side. Stone soldiers are immune to ball damage and move up the field, blocking and attacking enemies in the way.
Stone Effigy.effectCn: 每隔7-12行，从你的这一侧生成1个拥有200生命值的岩石士兵。岩石士兵免疫弹珠伤害，除此以外还会向上方移动，而且会阻挡并攻击敌人。

Wagon Wheel.name: Wagon Wheel
Wagon Wheel.effect: Each time a ball hits a wall, it deals 30 extra damage on the next hit
Wagon Wheel.effectCn: 每次命中屏幕上方的尽头区域后，弹珠下一次命中敌人将造成30额外伤害

Hourglass.name: Hourglass
Hourglass.effect: Balls deal 150 damage, but damage decays by 30 each time they bounce (minimum 50).
Hourglass.effectCn: 弹珠造成150伤害，但是每次反弹后伤害衰减30（最低50）。

Silver Bullet.name: Silver Bullet
Silver Bullet.effect: Balls deal 20 bonus damage until they hit a wall
Silver Bullet.effectCn: 在命中墙体之前，弹珠将造成20额外伤害。

Hand Mirror.name: Hand Mirror
Hand Mirror.effect: Projectiles have a 50 chance to reflect upon hitting you, dealing 20 - 40 damage if they hit an enemy
Hand Mirror.effectCn: 被投射物命中时有50几率反弹投射物，反弹的投射物将对命中的敌人造成20-40伤害。

Turret.name: Turret
Turret.effect: Floats around your character and shoots a baby ball at enemies every 20 seconds.
Turret.effectCn: 飘浮在你的角色周围，并且每隔20秒朝敌人发射1颗迷你弹珠

Hand Fan.name: Hand Fan
Hand Fan.effect: Slow down enemies in the same column as you by 50
Hand Fan.effectCn: 使与你处于同一列的敌人减速50

Iron Onesie.name: Iron Onesie
Iron Onesie.effect: Balls deal 5 more damage for each baby ball on the field.
Iron Onesie.effectCn: 场上每有1颗迷你弹珠，则弹珠额外造成5伤害。

Sword Breaker.name: Sword Breaker
Sword Breaker.effect: Balls deal 40 less damage, but gain 1 damage for each enemy on the field
Sword Breaker.effectCn: 弹珠伤害降低40，但是场上每有1名敌人，则获得1伤害加成。

Pressure Valve.name: Pressure Valve
Pressure Valve.effect: Enemies explode on death, dealing 20-30 damage to adjacent enemies.
Pressure Valve.effectCn: 敌人死亡时将爆炸，并对毗邻的敌人造成20-30伤害。

Magnet.name: Magnet
Magnet.effect: Increase range at which you pick up items and catch balls by 100 tiles.
Magnet.effectCn: 使你的物品拾取&弹珠接取范围扩大100格。

Bottled Tornado.name: Bottled Tornado
Bottled Tornado.effect: When you catch a special ball, automatically shoot 1 - 3 new baby balls in random directions.
Bottled Tornado.effectCn: 接住特殊弹珠时，自动朝随机方向发射1-3颗新的迷你弹珠。

Slingshot.name: Slingshot
Slingshot.effect: 25 chance to launch a baby ball when you pick up a gem.
Slingshot.effectCn: 拾取宝石时有25几率发射1颗迷你弹珠。

Soul Reaver.name: Soul Reaver
Soul Reaver.effect: Each kill heals you by 1 and you can heal past your max health at 30 efficiency.
Soul Reaver.effectCn: 每次击杀敌人为你恢复30，并且允许治疗效果超出最大生命值上限（1效率）。

Cornucopia.name: Cornucopia
Cornucopia.effect: Each time baby balls are created, spawn 0-1 additional baby balls
Cornucopia.effectCn: 每次创造迷你弹珠时，生成0-1颗额外迷你弹珠

Phantom Regalia.name: Phantom Regalia
Phantom Regalia.effect: Balls go through enemies until they hit the back wall. Balls deal 50 more damage when going through enemies.
Phantom Regalia.effectCn: 弹珠能够穿过敌人，直到命中屏幕上方的尽头区域。弹珠穿过敌人时将额外造成50伤害。

Odiferous Shell.name: Odiferous Shell
Odiferous Shell.effect: When you touch enemies, they have a 50 chance of instantly dying.
Odiferous Shell.effectCn: 当你触碰敌人时，它们有50几率立即死亡。

Gracious Impaler.name: Gracious Impaler
Gracious Impaler.effect: Critical hits have a 5 chance to instantly kill enemies
Gracious Impaler.effectCn: 暴击有5几率立即击杀敌人

Tormenters Mask.name: Tormenters Mask
Tormenters Mask.effect: Enemies have a 10 chance of dying immediately the first time they detect you.
Tormenters Mask.effectCn: 首次发现你（头顶显示惊叹号）时，敌人有10几率立即死亡。

Wings of the Anointed.name: Wings of the Anointed
Wings of the Anointed.effect: Balls move 40 faster and you move 20 faster. You no longer are affected by environmental hazards on the ground.
Wings of the Anointed.effectCn: 弹珠移动速度加快40，你的移动速度加快20。无视场地上的环境危险影响。

Deadeye's Impaler.name: Deadeye's Impaler
Deadeye's Impaler.effect: Increase critical hit chance to 50. Critical hits instantly kill non-boss enemies.
Deadeye's Impaler.effectCn: 暴击率提高至50。暴击将立即击杀非Boss敌人。

Argent Stopwatch.name: Argent Stopwatch
Argent Stopwatch.effect: Balls deal 200 damage, but damage decays by 20 each time they bounce (minimum 100).
Argent Stopwatch.effectCn: 弹珠造成200伤害，但是每次反弹后伤害衰减20（最低100）。

Arrow of Fate.name: Arrow of Fate
Arrow of Fate.effect: Projectiles no longer hurt you. Shoot 1-2 baby balls when hit by a projectile.
Arrow of Fate.effectCn: 投射物将不会再对你造成伤害。被投射物命中时发射1-2颗迷你弹珠。

Full Metal Rapier.name: Full Metal Rapier
Full Metal Rapier.effect: Balls deal 10 more damage for each baby ball and enemy on the field.
Full Metal Rapier.effectCn: 场上每有1颗迷你弹珠或1名敌人，则弹珠额外造成10伤害。

Grotesque Artillery.name: Grotesque Artillery
Grotesque Artillery.effect: Floats around your character and shoots a random level 1 unevolved special ball at enemies every 80 seconds.
Grotesque Artillery.effectCn: 飘浮在你的角色周围，并且每隔80秒朝敌人发射1颗1级且非进化过的弹珠。
